mission: Collector v1 S5 (PLAN §D1, §D4, §D5, §H row S5; owner decision Q2 approved 2026-10-11): browser holds no API token (server-side 5-minute token via /api/me), CORS restricted, collector-only guard on collector routes, /account, sign-in invite, /health and Sentry carry the API commit. Staging only; no collector release. COLLECTOR_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED is switched on separately on the staging API after this delivery is verified (owner finished PLAN §D2 2026-10-14).

impacts.reason: PLAN §D1 items 1 and 3 (owner decision Q2 approved 2026-10-11, which clears the auth-policy RED gate for this session): the Auth.js session object no longer carries apiToken. Collector requests go through same-origin route handlers (/api/me/**, /api/me/legacy/** for the pre-v1 pages until S8) that require a collector (Google) session, refuse cross-site mutating requests (Origin and Sec-Fetch-Site), mint a 5-minute HS256 API JWT server-side and call API_INTERNAL_URL. Admin sessions never get a user token. Legacy collector route handlers use the same helper. No secret value, variable or Auth.js cookie setting changes.

Collector routes (/collection, /wishlist, /account, legacy /analytics/*) require sessionKind collector; an admin session gets the sign-in invite. /admin/* unchanged (any session, expired-admin redirect, server-side admin boundary unchanged). /account added to the matcher and the crawler disallow list.

PLAN §D4/§D5 UI tranche (ATLAS loop, fresh visual reviewer PASS 4/4/4/4/4): /account (noindex, collector only) with profile, JPY currency, JSON/CSV export, typed-confirmation delete (S3 DELETE /me) and sign out; /sign-in invite with a next step in every state and an invite-only note while Google is in Testing mode; header Account link.

PLAN §D1 item 2: CORS options come from app/web_cors.py: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS if set (staging sets it to the alias today, so live behaviour is unchanged), else '*' only in development, the staging alias on staging, nothing otherwise; never credentials. app/settings.py is only read, not edited. Not a collector runtime input (scripts/collector_runtime_inputs.py: 0 changed inputs for SNKRDUNK 62 and Yuyu-Tei 73).
GET /me/profile (email, name, member since) for /account; behind COLLECTOR_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED like every /me route. app/accounts is outside the collector import graph.

Declares ARG RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA (Railway passes build-time variables to a Dockerfile only when declared, docs.railway.com/guides/dockerfiles, checked 2026-10-14) and sets GIT_COMMIT from it, falling back to the GIT_COMMIT build arg, so /health and the Sentry release carry the deployed commit instead of 'unknown'. Not a collector Dockerfile or collector path (full_paths).

Collector vs admin session; expired admin; no bearer token in the session JSON or client modules; 5-minute token; CSRF on every mutating collector route; BFF path allowlist; account page states and typed delete; CORS refuses other origins; /me/profile; import graph.
Token flow, CORS default and /api/me documented; ATLAS tranche contract.

No migration.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR restores the previous session/token flow, CORS code default and pages; unset COLLECTOR_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED on the staging API to make every /me route 404 again; the owner can disable the Google client. No data migration to undo.
recovery.trigger: Admin login broken; any bearer token visible in the browser or session JSON; public pages failing CORS; verifier failure; /me answering for a non-collector session.
recovery.backup: No schema or row change in this PR. Railway Postgres daily backup 4654fa96-c582-4dfb-a3fc-74c0759263be created 2026-10-14T09:22:01Z (under 24 h at merge) covers the later flag enablement.

verification.observation_window: Delivery receipt with 0 collector rollouts; on the staging alias: admin login works, /api/auth/session and page requests carry no bearer token, the API refuses another origin, /health reports the merge commit; after the flag is on, the owner's test account signs in, /account, export and delete work, and a read-only count confirms the user is gone.
